cases.name: optimize-measured-bottleneck
cases.description: The optimization starts from evidence, preserves behavior, and remeasures after each meaningful change.
cases.prompt: A profile shows repeated data-frame growth inside a hot loop. Propose an optimization workflow and explain what must be checked before adopting it.
traps: Rewrites the code without a baseline
Assumes preallocation is always faster without checking behavior

assertions.text: Establishes a realistic baseline and target before changing the implementation.
Considers preallocation or whole-object operations while recognizing their contract and memory tradeoffs.
Remeasures the realistic workload after the change.

cases.name: equivalence-and-memory
cases.description: The faster candidate is accepted only when its output contract and resource profile fit the use case.
cases.prompt: A vectorized implementation is faster but allocates a large temporary matrix and changes a date-like class. Decide how to evaluate it.
traps: Accepts speed without checking attributes or peak memory

assertions.text: Checks values, types, dimensions, names, classes, ordering, and missingness against a reference.
Balances elapsed time against allocation and peak-memory constraints.
Treats internals and unchecked shortcuts as last-resort techniques.
